duration.text: The Chinese language program at Zhejiang Gongshang University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 972 USD/per year ￥ 7000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Highest academic degree certificate and course transcript 2. Valid passport 3.2-inch photo 4. "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" 5. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit a parent authorization letter and a guardian guarantee letter (please see the download link at the end of the document) 6. Certificate of No Criminal Record 7. Receipt for Application Fee Remittance

requirements.text: 1. Citizens of non-Chinese nationality, aged between 18 and 60, in good physical and mental health and with proper conduct. 2. Should have equivalent educational qualifications to a high school diploma; 3. For international students who are studying the language courses, if they wish to apply for the Chinese language program at our school, they must provide the original certificate of completion and demonstrate an attendance rate of 90% or higher. 4. International students who have already obtained a degree in China are not eligible to apply for this program.
